title: Jonah and the Echo
author: August Thackeray
blurb: Cyrus Kavanagh, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
